comment: Differences between Babel4Pascal (CLDR 47) and ICU4C (78.2, CLDR 48) that do not come from Babel4Pascal's code: data differences, each of which disappears when the library is built from CLDR 48's data (tests/icu/README.md), and the ICU API behaviors named. Keys: operation, field (pattern, style, skeleton, unit/width, list style or unit/length) and locale. tests/icu/check_icu.py fails on a difference not listed here and on a listed one that no longer occurs.
